literal_meaning: আপোস বা সমঝোতার দলিল (etymologically possibly from Persian 'sulh-nama' meaning peace document)
figurative_meaning_en: Document of compromise or settlement in a dispute
example_sentences_in_bangla: দুই পক্ষের মধ্যে ছোলেনামা স্বাক্ষরিত হয়েছে।
আদালতে গিয়ে ছোলেনামা করে তারা মামলা শেষ করল।
example_sentences_in_english: A cholenama was signed between the two parties.
They went to court and ended the case with a compromise document.
note: This is a specialized legal term in Bengali, often used in formal dispute resolutions; variant 'সোলেনামা' may derive from historical Persian influences in Bengali legal language.
